verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for invoicing software, since some invoicing tools can be self-hosted, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Stripe-hosted invoices, the Dashboard, a cloud API, a CLI and an MCP server. Nothing documents running the core product on your own infrastructure. The CLI 'sandbox' is a Stripe test environment, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
